L6:C8.description: Both the east and west walls of this hall are crazed with cracks around thin, poorly set patches of brick. A sticky residue glistens across the floor, and sparks crackle along the wall seams. A heavy shutter leads south, back toward the ember-strewn hall.

L6:D8.name: Hall of Twin Fires
L6:D8.description: Two fires burn in dragon-shaped braziers at the far end of this quiet room, and an old man stands between them. He urges aiming at the eyes of the beast in the nest nearby. A shutter leads south, and the west wall is cracked and weak.

L6:E8.name: Triforce Chamber
L6:E8.description: A sanctum of polished red stone glows with a soft golden light that warms the dragon carvings along its walls. The heat and smoke of the halls below are gone, and the air is clear and still. A shutter leads back south to the nest.

L6:cellar:B8.name: Magical Rod Cellar
L6:cellar:B8.description: A ladder drops from beneath the loose block into a cramped basement of dark brick. Brick ledges step across a floor that hums with a faint, prickling power, and the air smells of ozone. The only way out is back up the ladder.

L7:A1.name: Hall of Shed Skins
L7:A1.description: Pale, papery snakeskins lie curled in the corners of this low chamber, and thin sinuous tracks wind through the grit on the floor. The walls are cold and close, and a faint hiss seems to linger in the air long after any sound has stopped. The only way out is the open doorway to the north.

L7:B1.name: Demon's Gate
L7:B1.description: Damp stone steps come down from the drained pond above into a vestibule of green-black brick. Water still beads on the walls and gathers in the seams between the floor tiles, and the air smells of silt and old reeds. Open archways lead north and east into the dark.

L7:C1.name: Dripping Antechamber
L7:C1.description: A bare square chamber whose blue-green flagstones are slick with seep from the pond overhead. The only sound is a slow, patient dripping that echoes from every wall. An open archway leads west toward the entry stair, and another opens north into deeper halls.

L7:A2.name: Blade Trap Corridor
L7:A2.description: Deep grooves are worn into the floor between the corners, where blocks of spiked iron sit in shallow recesses, polished bright by endless sliding. The ceiling is low and hung with roosting stains. A spiderweb of cracks runs through the east wall, and open doorways lead north and south.

L7:B2.name: Moat Crossroads
L7:B2.description: A channel of black water rings a raised island of flagstones at the heart of this room, its surface still and cold. Narrow stone lips along the walls let a traveller skirt the moat to reach the open doorways east and south. Both the north and west walls are fractured and hollow-looking, as if a sharp blast would bring them down.

L7:C2.name: Bat Roost
L7:C2.description: White streaks of guano stain the walls of this chamber from the ceiling down, and the air is sour with it. Leathery rustling drifts from the shadowed rafters and dies away. Open doorways lead west, east and south, while the north wall bears a jagged crack running from floor to lintel.

L7:D2.name: Shuttered Gallery
L7:D2.description: Two rows of squat stone blocks march down the middle of this long gallery, leaving narrow lanes between them. Boomerang notches are chipped into the brickwork at shoulder height. A heavy iron shutter seals the north doorway, while open arches lead east and west.

L7:E2.name: Urchin's Hollow
L7:E2.description: Coarse sand has drifted across the floor of this chamber, and great round depressions are pressed into it as though something vast had rolled from wall to wall. Broken spines as long as a forearm lie scattered among the dunes. The room is unnaturally quiet; even footsteps seem swallowed. Open arches lead east and west.

L7:F2.name: Bone-Strewn Alcove
L7:F2.description: The far eastern end of the dungeon gathers into a cramped alcove littered with skulls, ribs and rusted sword hilts. Some of the bones look disturbed, shuffled into heaps that were not there before. The stale air carries a dry rattle, and the only way out is the open arch to the west.

L7:A3.name: Dodongo Den
L7:A3.description: Huge three-toed prints are pressed into the soot that coats this chamber, and the walls are scorched black in broad sweeping arcs. A thick reptilian musk hangs in the air alongside a whiff of brimstone. A sturdy locked door with an iron keyhole stands in the north wall; open doorways lead east and south.

L7:B3.name: Boomerang Hall
L7:B3.description: A square hall of green brick whose walls are gouged with curved nicks where thrown blades have struck and spun away. A worn track circles the floor around a single central block. A heavy shutter seals the east doorway, the south wall is cracked through, and open arches lead north and west.

L7:C3.name: Hall of Bones
L7:C3.description: Raised blocks stand in a checkerboard across this wide chamber, and every lane between them is choked with bones, shields and helmets green with age. The clatter of loose ribs underfoot sets echoes running along the walls. A heavy shutter guards the west doorway, and the south wall is split by a ragged crack.

L7:D3.name: The Old Man's Fires
L7:D3.description: Two fires burn in stone braziers on either side of a quiet figure in a red robe, and their light dances across the plain walls. A faint murmur hangs in the warm air, something about a secret in the tip of the nose. The room is otherwise bare, and a heavy shutter seals the south doorway.

L7:A4.name: Hall of the Second Sage
L7:A4.description: Twin flames crackle in low braziers, framing a robed elder who speaks of a sound the great urchin cannot bear. The firelight warms the stones of a small, square room that feels strangely safe after the halls below. The only way out is the iron-banded door with a keyhole in the south wall.

L7:B4.name: Hall of Lingering Chill
L7:B4.description: An unnatural chill pools near the floor of this chamber, and the torchless walls seem to glimmer with a faint, shifting light. Pairs of stone blocks flank the center like silent guards. An open arch leads south, and a heavy iron shutter seals the passage north.

L7:A5.name: Western Moat
L7:A5.description: A broad moat cuts across this chamber, its dark water lapping softly against a narrow causeway of stone that bends toward the far doors. The smell of wet moss is thick. A locked door with a brass keyhole stands to the north, and a heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L7:B5.name: Island Chamber
L7:B5.description: A ring of still water surrounds a square island of flagstones in the middle of this room, and the reflections of the walls ripple whenever a drop falls from the ceiling. Heavy shutters seal the south and west doorways. The east wall is crumbling and hollow-sounding, as if little holds it together.

L7:C5.name: Hidden Cistern
L7:C5.description: Behind a broken wall lies a small forgotten cistern, its floor sunk a step lower than the rest of the dungeon and slick with standing water. Moss grows thick in the corners, and the air is close and still. The only way out is the ragged gap in the west wall.

L7:A6.name: Hall of Grumbling
L7:A6.description: Gnawed bones and an empty clay bowl lie before the north doorway, and a deep rumbling grumble seems to rise from the stones themselves. Whoever keeps this passage is plainly starving, and will let no one by on an empty stomach. A heavy shutter seals the north way, and a locked door stands to the south.

L7:B6.name: Stairwell of the Demon
L7:B6.description: A narrow stone stair drops away through the floor in one corner of this chamber, descending into a long, dripping passage that runs far beneath the dungeon. The surrounding blocks are carved with leering, horned faces. The east wall is cracked and blistered from some great heat beyond it.

L7:C6.name: Aquamentus's Lair
L7:C6.description: A long hall of scorched brick ends at a raised ledge where something huge and horned has worn the stone smooth. The walls are pocked with blackened craters, and the air is thick with smoke and the reek of burnt scale. A cracked wall leads back west, and a heavy shutter bars the east.

L7:D6.name: Triforce Chamber
L7:D6.description: A hush fills this small, high chamber, broken only by a faint golden hum that seems to come from the stones themselves. The floor rises in shallow steps to a plain stone dais at its center, swept clean as if by reverent hands. The only way out is the heavy shutter to the west.

L7:A7.name: Teeming Moat Hall
L7:A7.description: Dark water runs in a broad channel around the edges of this crowded hall, leaving a broad central floor scattered with feathers, droppings and chipped boomerang wood. The noise of the place never quite stops. A locked door stands east, a shutter seals the south, and the north wall is visibly cracked.

L7:B7.name: Twin Pillar Hall
L7:B7.description: Two massive square pillars of green stone rise from the floor of this hall, their bases worn smooth where countless hands have steadied themselves. Water trickles in a thin sheet down the north wall beside a heavy shutter. A locked door leads west, and the east wall is fractured and loose.

L7:C7.name: Hall of the Loose Block
L7:C7.description: Blocks of carved stone stand in neat rows across this chamber, all but one set firmly into the floor. That one sits a finger's width out of line, with fresh scrape marks in the dust beside it. Both the east and west walls are cracked through, as though once broken and badly mended.

L7:D7.name: Hall of Keyholes
L7:D7.description: Two stout doors banded with iron face this chamber from the north and east, each with a dark keyhole at its heart. Between them the floor is laid in a tight spiral of tiles that draws the eye inward. The west wall is cracked from floor to ceiling and looks ready to give.

L7:E7.name: Spined Sand Pit
L7:E7.description: Fine sand has been heaped into ridges across this chamber, ploughed into furrows by something round and heavy. Snapped spines jut from the drifts like broken arrows, and the hush here is deep enough to ring in the ears. A locked door leads west, and a heavy shutter seals the north.

L7:A8.name: Forgotten Corner
L7:A8.description: Dust lies undisturbed on the floor of this sealed corner chamber, and cobwebs drape the bare walls in grey veils. No door was ever hung here; the only ways in are the crumbling walls to the south and east, which sound hollow and fragile to the touch.

L7:B8.name: Northern Moat Room
L7:B8.description: A moat of black water bends around three sides of this chamber, leaving a raised stone floor where scraps of goriya armour lie rusting. The water smells of rot and iron. Heavy shutters seal the east and south doorways, and the west wall is split by a long, deep crack.

L7:C8.name: Goriya Barracks
L7:C8.description: Matted heaps of straw line the walls of this cramped room, and half-carved boomerangs and wood shavings litter the floor beside a cold firepit. It smells of fur and stale meat. The only way out is the heavy shutter in the west wall.

L7:D8.name: Silent Vault
L7:D8.description: A small, empty vault at the top of the dungeon, its walls lined with smooth slabs of dark stone that drink the light. Nothing stirs, and the dripping heard elsewhere does not reach here. The only exit is the locked door to the south.

L7:E8.name: Smoke-Stained Den
L7:E8.description: The ceiling of this low den is blackened with old smoke, and great scaly hide scrapings cling to the corners where something heavy has rubbed itself against the brick. A sulfurous fug hangs over the floor. A heavy shutter seals the south doorway, and the east wall is fractured and weak.

L7:F8.name: Grasping Wall Chamber
L7:F8.description: Long gouges run down the walls of this chamber as if great fingers had dragged themselves out of the stone and back again. A stone stair in one corner leads down into a dripping passage that winds far to the west. The west wall is cracked and loose.

L7:cellar:C7.name: Red Candle Cellar
L7:cellar:C7.description: Below the loose block, a ladder descends into a narrow basement of rough red brick. A single ledge runs the length of the cellar above a black, bottomless gap, and the air is warm and faintly waxy. The ladder rises back to the hall above.

L8:B1.name: Tomb of Wrappings
L8:B1.description: Shreds of yellowed linen wrapping cling to the corners of this cold chamber, and the air carries a dry, spiced smell of old embalming. Stone blocks stand in a neat row along the floor, one of them resting a little crooked with scrape marks at its base. A heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L8:C1.name: Western Antechamber
L8:C1.description: A plain chamber of pale grey brick, its floor swept bare save for a few drifts of ash carried in from the entry stair. The silence is heavy and expectant. An open arch leads east, and a heavy iron shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:D1.name: Lion's Gate
L8:D1.description: Fine grey ash sifts down the stair from the burned bush overhead, settling on the first flagstones of a stern stone vestibule. Carved lion heads glare from the corners, their stone manes chipped with age. Open archways lead west, north and east.

L8:E1.name: Eastern Roost
L8:E1.description: Droppings streak the walls of this small dead-end chamber, and a faint chill lingers near the floor no matter how still the air. Fluttering echoes come and go from the shadowed ceiling. The only way out is the open arch to the west.

L8:D2.name: Narrow Passage Hall
L8:D2.description: A tall, narrow hall of grey stone runs north from the entry, its walls lined with shallow alcoves where stone lions once crouched. Only their broken paws remain. The open arch south leads back to the gate, and the north wall is cracked and crumbling.

L8:B3.name: Quiet Western Cell
L8:B3.description: A small, forgotten cell at the western edge of the dungeon, its floor clean and its walls unmarked. A thin draught sighs through the open arch to the east, carrying the faint smell of damp stone. Nothing here seems to have been disturbed in a very long time.

L8:C3.name: Hall of Echoes
L8:C3.description: Every sound in this high chamber comes back doubled and trebled from the bare walls, so that a single footstep becomes a march. Tufts of pale fur cling to the corners. Open arches lead west and north, and a heavy iron shutter seals the doorway east.

L8:D3.name: Slime-Slick Crossing
L8:D3.description: Glistening trails of green slime crisscross the flagstones of this four-way chamber, and the floor gives a faint squelch underfoot. A locked door with a keyhole stands to the east, heavy shutters guard the north and west, and the south wall is cracked through.

L8:E3.name: Warren of Long Ears
L8:E3.description: Pale fur drifts like snow across the floor of this crowded chamber, and the walls are scuffed low down by countless thumping feet. The air is warm and musky, and even the slightest sound seems to set something stirring. A locked door leads back west.

L8:A4.name: Gel-Streaked Chamber
L8:A4.description: Puddles of quivering green gel cling to the floor of this chamber, and wet smears trail up the base of the walls. The air is damp and smells faintly sweet and rotten. An open arch leads north, and a heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L8:B4.name: Stair Beneath the Lion
L8:B4.description: A steep stone stair opens in one corner of this chamber, leading down into a passage that runs far to the east beneath the dungeon. A great stone lion's head is carved above the stairwell. The west doorway is shuttered, and the north wall is scorched and cracked.

L8:C4.name: Hall of Crouching Lions
L8:C4.description: Four stone lions crouch at the corners of this square hall, their blank eyes fixed on the middle of the floor. The paving between them is cracked in a starburst pattern. An open arch leads south, a heavy shutter seals the north, and a locked door stands to the east.

L8:D4.name: Locked Crossway
L8:D4.description: Two iron-bound doors with dark keyholes face this chamber from the north and west, and the floor between them is slick with old slime. A faint chill clings near the ceiling, and the walls weep a cold sweat. A heavy shutter seals the south doorway.

L8:A5.name: Sage of the Northern Fire
L8:A5.description: Two fires burn in stone braziers at the heart of this small, warm room, and between them the stones are worn smooth where an elder has long stood. A grave whisper hangs in the air, warning that Spectacle Rock is an entrance to death. An open arch leads south, and the east wall is cracked.

L8:B5.name: Gleeok's Lair
L8:B5.description: Four deep troughs are gouged into the north wall where great serpentine necks have thrashed against the stone, and the floor below is blackened with flame. The heat is stifling and the air tastes of ash. A heavy shutter seals the north, and cracked walls lead south and west.

L8:C5.name: Sage of the Tenth Foe
L8:C5.description: Twin fires crackle on either side of a quiet spot where a robed elder keeps watch, and their warm light fills the little chamber. A murmured counsel hangs in the air: the tenth foe carries the bomb. The only way out is the heavy shutter to the south.

L8:D5.name: Chamber of Three Doors
L8:D5.description: A plain chamber of grey stone where three very different ways out meet: a locked door with a keyhole to the south, a heavy iron shutter to the east, and a north wall split by a deep, ragged crack. The floor is bare and the silence is heavy.

L8:E5.name: Knight's Guardroom
L8:E5.description: Dented shields and broken spear shafts are stacked against the walls of this guardroom, and the floor is scored by the tread of heavy armoured boots. Strips of old linen hang from a rack. A stone stair in the corner leads down into a passage running west, and a shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:B6.name: Triforce Chamber
L8:B6.description: Golden light seems to glow faintly from the walls of this small, still chamber, though no flame burns anywhere within it. A plain stone dais stands at its center, swept clean and quiet. The only way out is the heavy shutter to the south, back toward the scorched lair.

L8:C6.name: Lion's Den
L8:C6.description: A large stone lion lies carved along the length of the west wall, its head resting on its paws as though asleep. The rest of the chamber is empty, cool and very still. An open arch leads north, and the east wall is cracked through.

L8:D6.name: Cartographer's Hall
L8:D6.description: Faded lines are scratched into the walls of this hall, as though someone once tried to chart the dungeon on its very stones. A locked door with a keyhole stands in the north wall, and both the south and west walls are cracked and hollow-sounding.

L8:C7.name: Burrow Chamber
L8:C7.description: Shallow scrapes and burrow holes pock the earthen corners of this chamber, and tufts of pale fur catch on every rough edge. The quiet here is uneasy, broken by faint scratching. An open arch leads south, and the east wall is fractured and weak.

L8:D7.name: Northern Crossroads
L8:D7.description: A broad chamber where four ways meet: heavy iron shutters to the north and east, a locked door with a keyhole to the south, and a cracked wall to the west. Carved lions' heads glower down from the lintel of every door. The floor is clean and bare.

L8:E7.name: Hall of the Shifted Block
L8:E7.description: Rows of grey blocks fill this chamber, and green slime glistens in the gaps between them. One block stands slightly out of line, a curved scrape in the floor showing where it has been moved before. A heavy shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:D8.name: Ooze-Drenched Chamber
L8:D8.description: The northernmost chamber of the dungeon is slick with puddles of trembling green ooze that cling to the walls in thick, dripping sheets. The air is damp and cloying. The only way out is the heavy shutter in the south wall.

L8:cellar:B1.name: Magic Book Cellar
L8:cellar:B1.description: Beneath the crooked block, a ladder leads down into a narrow basement of rough brick that smells of dust and old parchment. A single stone ledge runs above a dark drop, and faint chalk runes mark the walls. The ladder climbs back to the tomb above.

L8:cellar:E7.name: Magical Key Cellar
L8:cellar:E7.description: A ladder descends from the shifted block into a cramped brick basement, its far end crossed by a single stone ledge above a black gap. A faint metallic chime seems to hang in the still air. The ladder leads back up to the hall above.

L9:B1.name: Stairwell Antechamber
L9:B1.description: A narrow dead-end chamber at the dungeon's southern edge, its walls pressing close and its ceiling low. Damp seeps from the stone and pools in the cracks of the floor. A stair in one corner plunges into a tunnel running east beneath the rock, and an open doorway leads back north.

L9:D1.name: Chamber of Locked Doors
L9:D1.description: Scorch marks spatter the walls here in uneven arcs, the work of bolts flung in anger. The room is a small stone box with no open way out at all: a stout locked door stands in the north wall and another in the east, both with keyholes rimmed in tarnished brass.

L9:E1.name: Furrowed Sand Pit
L9:E1.description: Loose grey sand covers the floor of this chamber, churned into long winding furrows as though something huge has burrowed through it again and again. The air tastes of grit. A locked door with a keyhole stands in the west wall, and a stairway sunk in the sand descends into a passage running west.

L9:G1.name: Gate Beneath Spectacle Rock
L9:G1.description: Cold air pours down from the mountain's heart into this bare stone vestibule, carved where the twin crags of Spectacle Rock meet the ground. The walls are rough, sooty basalt veined with dull red, and the floor is worn smooth by centuries of grit. An open archway leads north into the dark, and a low, constant rumble seems to come from the rock itself.

L9:B2.name: Eye of the Western Hall
L9:B2.description: A swirl of dust turns slowly in the middle of this chamber, stirred by some unseen current that circles and circles again. The walls are smooth, dark stone, and a flight of steps in the floor descends into a hidden underground passage. Open doorways lead north, south and east.

L9:C2.name: Roost of the Keese
L9:C2.description: Bat droppings crust the ledges of this low, vaulted room, and the ceiling is pocked with crevices where small wings rustle in the dark. Rows of rough blocks line the floor like broken teeth. An open doorway leads west, and a locked door with a heavy keyhole guards the way east.

L9:D2.name: Slime-Slick Junction
L9:D2.description: The floor of this chamber glistens with a film of greenish ooze that clings to the boots and smells of rot. Iron-bound doors with keyholes stand in the north, south and west walls, and only the east archway hangs open. In one corner, steps cut into the stone drop away into a narrow underground passage.

L9:E2.name: Crossroads of Ash
L9:E2.description: Four squat blocks stand in a square at the room's center, their tops dusted with grey ash that drifts down from somewhere far above. Faint slime trails curl between them, and scorch marks dapple the flagstones. Open archways lead west, north and east, making this a place where the dungeon's paths first begin to divide.

L9:F2.name: Scorched Vestibule
L9:F2.description: Blackened rings and starbursts of soot mark the floor and walls, as though bolts of fire have been hurled here again and again. The smell of burnt stone hangs in the still air. A shutter door bars the way east, an open passage runs west, and the northern wall shows a web of fine cracks around one patch of mortar.

L9:G2.name: Hall of the First Warning
L9:G2.description: Two fires burn in iron braziers on either side of an aged figure, and their light barely reaches the black corners of the chamber. The old man murmurs that the true road lies onward, through the next room. Heavy shutter doors seal the west and north walls, while the archway south opens back toward the mountain gate.

L9:A3.name: Ooze-Pooled Corner
L9:A3.description: Puddles of thick ooze collect in the hollows of the uneven floor, quivering faintly whenever a breath of air passes. The corner chamber is dim and cramped, its walls blotched with mildew. A shutter door seals the east wall, and a locked door with a keyhole leads north.

L9:B3.name: Hall of Half-Eaten Shields
L9:B3.description: Bent shield straps and dissolved scraps of leather lie scattered across the floor, coated in a clear, sticky residue. The room smells of something that digests slowly. Shutter doors guard the north and west, and an open archway leads south.

L9:C3.name: Whirling Dust Chamber
L9:C3.description: Grit hangs in the air in a slow, circling cloud, as if the room itself were a whirlpool of dust. Ranks of blocks line the walls, and in one corner a stair leads down into a tunnel that runs far beneath the dungeon. An open doorway leads east and a shutter door seals the north.

L9:D3.name: Hall of Shadows and Flame
L9:D3.description: Scorch marks, slime trails and a strange chill all share this crowded chamber, as if every terror of the mountain passed through it. Two lines of blocks divide the floor into lanes. A locked door leads south, an open doorway west, and one section of the north wall looks thin and crumbling.

L9:E3.name: Hall of Twin Pillars
L9:E3.description: Two great pillars of black stone flank the center of this room, each wrapped in a spiral of soot from bolts that struck and glanced away. The silence here is heavy. Open archways lead north and south, while the eastern wall bears a long hairline crack.

L9:F3.name: The Sealed Sand Hollow
L9:F3.description: Every wall of this sandy chamber is solid, smooth and doorless, but each shows a faint web of cracks where the stone has been weakened. Long furrows wind through the sand on the floor. A stairway in one corner sinks into a tunnel leading north, the only clear way out.

L9:G3.name: Gallery of Ooze
L9:G3.description: Slime coats the lower walls of this long gallery in shining streaks, and a cold, unnatural shiver hangs in the air near the corners. The floor is set with scattered blocks. A shutter door lies to the south, an open doorway north, and the west wall shows a cracked and sagging patch.

L9:H3.name: Eastern Spellward
L9:H3.description: A secluded chamber at the dungeon's eastern edge, its walls branded with soot in strange, star-shaped patterns. Rows of dark blocks stand in neat columns down its length. The only way out is an open archway to the north.

L9:A4.name: Corridor of Burnt Runes
L9:A4.description: The western wall of this narrow room is carved with runes, and most of them have been scorched black by passing fire. The air is warm and dry and smells of smoke. Locked doors with keyholes lead north and south, and the room offers no other way through.

L9:B4.name: Hall of Grinding Blades
L9:B4.description: Deep grooves are worn into the floor in straight lines from each corner toward the center, as though heavy blades have slid back and forth across them countless times. Torn leather scraps lie in sticky heaps. Shutter doors stand at the north and south ends.

L9:C4.name: Ganon's Dark Chamber
L9:C4.description: Darkness fills this vast hall so completely that no lamp seems able to push it back. The air is hot and foul, thick with the reek of a beast, and the stone underfoot is scarred with deep claw marks. Shutter doors stand to the south, and on the north wall a great golden door gleams faintly, sealed with a heavy lock.

L9:D4.name: Hidden Sage's Alcove
L9:D4.description: Sealed away behind crumbling stone, this small room is lit only by twin fires that crackle beside an old man. He speaks softly of secrets kept where fairies do not live. The only way back is the broken wall to the south.

L9:E4.name: Chamber of Scorch Rings
L9:E4.description: Overlapping rings of black soot cover the floor, many layers deep, as though fire has burst here from every direction at once. Heat lingers in the stone long after the flames have gone. Open archways lead east and south.

L9:F4.name: Crowded Sorcery Hall
L9:F4.description: Slime, soot and a lingering cold chill mark this busy hall in equal measure. Low blocks stand in pairs across the floor, leaving narrow lanes between them. A doorway opens west, a locked door with a keyhole leads east, and the south wall looks cracked and weak.

L9:G4.name: Hall of Blue Flames
L9:G4.description: Strange pale scorch marks, more blue than black, streak the walls of this chamber, and the air crackles faintly with leftover magic. The floor is bare except for a few scattered blocks. A locked door leads west and an open doorway leads south.

L9:H4.name: Eastern Wardroom
L9:H4.description: A cold draft whispers through this chamber, and with it comes a strange unease that makes the torchlight waver. Soot stains streak the walls between plain stone blocks. Open archways lead north and south along the dungeon's eastern edge.

L9:A5.name: Blade-Trap Stairwell
L9:A5.description: Deep grooves cut the floor from each corner, worn by heavy blades that slam toward the center. Soot marks the walls above them. A locked door leads south, the east wall bears a crumbling, fractured section, and a stair in the floor descends into a long passage beneath the dungeon.

L9:B5.name: Hall of Many Dangers
L9:B5.description: Signs of every kind of menace crowd this hall: slime trails, scorched stone, and a strange chill clinging to the walls. Blocks stand in a ring around the center. Shutter doors lead north and south, and a cracked patch in the west wall hints at a hidden way.

L9:C5.name: Princess Zelda's Chamber
L9:C5.description: Warm light fills this quiet room, cast by two fires that burn steadily on either side of its center. After the darkness below, the air is clean and still, and the plain stone walls seem almost gentle. A single shutter door leads back south toward the dark chamber.

L9:D5.name: Pool of Gel
L9:D5.description: Small, jiggling droplets of jelly cling to every surface of this room, quivering with a life of their own. The floor is slick and gives off a sour, wet smell. A locked door with a keyhole leads north, and the east wall shows a thin, crumbling section.

L9:E5.name: Bat-Haunted Gallery
L9:E5.description: The rustle of leathery wings never quite stops in this high gallery, and droppings streak the walls below its dark ledges. A thin crack runs through the western wall. An open archway leads north. The stone underfoot is cold and gritty, and the air smells of must.

L9:F5.name: Chamber of the Needle
L9:F5.description: A narrow chamber, its walls scarred with scorch marks that point in every direction like the arms of a compass rose. The floor is laid with a pattern of dark and pale tiles. The only visible way out is a stretch of cracked and weakened stone in the north wall.

L9:G5.name: Murky Junction
L9:G5.description: Ooze, bat droppings and a strange lingering cold make this room an unpleasant place to linger. Rows of blocks divide the floor. A locked door with a keyhole leads north, and the east wall shows a long, fractured seam in the stone.

L9:H5.name: Belfry of the Vires
L9:H5.description: High overhead, the ceiling vanishes into blackness where something winged and heavy roosts; claw marks rake the upper walls. Shattered bits of stone litter the floor. An open archway leads south, while cracked sections mar both the north and west walls.

L9:A6.name: Western Stair Room
L9:A6.description: Scorched rings mark the floor around a stair that sinks into a tunnel running beneath the dungeon. The walls here are thick and dark, and the air is uncomfortably warm. There is no open doorway, but the north wall shows a web of fractures in the stone.

L9:B6.name: Circling Wind Chamber
L9:B6.description: A slow, endless wind circles this room, carrying fine dust round and round the walls. Swirling marks are scoured into the floor. Shutter doors lead north and south, and a cracked section of the east wall looks ready to give way.

L9:C6.name: Hall of Slime and Shadow
L9:C6.description: Pools of slime gleam on the floor in the shadow of tall stone blocks, and a strange chill hangs near the walls. Locked doors with keyholes lead north and east, while the western wall shows a crumbling, fractured patch. The air is damp.

L9:D6.name: Gel-Choked Crossway
L9:D6.description: Tiny quivering blobs of jelly cling to the walls and floor of this crossing, leaving a slick, sour-smelling film everywhere. Locked doors with keyholes stand in the north, south and west walls, and a cracked section of the east wall looks weak.

L9:E6.name: Winged Watchtower
L9:E6.description: The ceiling here rises into a tall, dark shaft, and claw marks streak its upper walls where heavy wings have gripped the stone. A cold draft spills down from above. Open archways lead north and south, and the west wall bears a thin crack.

L9:F6.name: Ooze-Streaked Passage
L9:F6.description: Streaks of slime run down the walls of this narrow chamber, and a cold, uneasy feeling lingers in the air. Rows of dark blocks line the floor. A locked door leads east, while the north and south walls both show cracked, weakened stone.

L9:G6.name: Hall of Quivering Gel
L9:G6.description: Little blobs of jelly quiver on every flagstone, leaving sticky trails behind them. The room smells sour and damp. An open archway leads north, locked doors stand to the south and west, and a cracked patch scars the east wall.

L9:H6.name: The Cartographer's Vault
L9:H6.description: Dust spins in a slow circle across the floor of this sealed eastern vault, as if stirred by an endless breath. Faded lines are etched into the walls like old surveyors' marks. There are no doorways at all, only cracked and weakened sections in the north, south and west walls.

L9:A7.name: Sealed Western Sanctum
L9:A7.description: Scorch marks and a strange chill fill this isolated corner room, and the floor is laid with a careful arrangement of stone blocks. One block sits slightly out of line with the rest, its base scraped clean. The only exit is a cracked section of the south wall.

L9:B7.name: Sand Burrow Hall
L9:B7.description: Coarse grey sand fills this hall, heaped into ridges and churned by long winding furrows. A dry, earthy smell rises from the disturbed ground. Shutter doors stand at the north and south ends. Here and there the sand has collapsed into hollows, as if the ground were hollow beneath.

L9:C7.name: Red Sand Hall
L9:C7.description: The sand on this floor is rust-red and churned into deep twisting furrows, as if something has been tunneling here without rest. Locked doors with keyholes lead east and south, and a shutter door seals the north. The air is dry and close.

L9:D7.name: Silent Cell
L9:D7.description: A small, quiet chamber with a strange chill in the air that seems to gather and drift without any wind. The floor is bare and the walls plain. Locked doors with keyholes lead south and west, and there is no other way out.

L9:E7.name: Stair of the Devourers
L9:E7.description: Sticky residue coats the floor around a stair that drops into a tunnel running deep beneath the dungeon. Scraps of chewed leather lie in heaps along the walls. An open archway leads south, and a locked door with a keyhole guards the east.

L9:F7.name: Blue-Scorched Hall
L9:F7.description: Pale bluish scorch marks streak the walls in straight lines, crossing and recrossing one another. The air carries the sharp smell of spent magic. An open doorway leads east, a locked door west, and the south wall shows a web of cracks.

L9:G7.name: Northern Whirl Chamber
L9:G7.description: A slow vortex of dust circles the center of this chamber, endlessly turning. The walls are smooth and dark, lined with low blocks. An open doorway leads west and another south, and a locked door with a keyhole guards the north.

L9:H7.name: Eastern Gauntlet
L9:H7.description: Slime, soot and a lingering cold chill fill this long chamber, every trace of danger crowded into one place. Rows of blocks run along the walls. Cracked and weakened sections of stone mark both the north and south walls.

L9:B8.name: Northwestern Den
L9:B8.description: Ooze, bat droppings and a strange lingering chill make this dim corner chamber unwelcoming. Low blocks are scattered across the floor. A shutter door leads south, and a locked door with a heavy keyhole guards the way east.

L9:C8.name: Sage of the Northern Hall
L9:C8.description: Twin fires burn on either side of an old man who keeps a lonely vigil in this quiet chamber. He mutters that the one who circles holds the map. A shutter door leads south and a locked door west. The fires cast long, wavering shadows across the bare stone floor.

L9:D8.name: Stair of Slime
L9:D8.description: Slime coats the walls of this room in glistening sheets, and a cold presence seems to drift near the ceiling. A stair in one corner descends into a long tunnel beneath the dungeon. The east wall shows a cracked and crumbling patch.

L9:E8.name: Quiet Stair Landing
L9:E8.description: A small, empty chamber, strangely still after the rest of the dungeon. A worn stair in the floor descends into a passage that runs far to the west and south. The west wall shows a web of fine cracks in the stone. Dust lies thick and undisturbed.

L9:F8.name: Northern Stair of Flame
L9:F8.description: Scorch marks blacken the walls around a stair that plunges into a tunnel leading back toward the dungeon's southern halls. The air here is warm and smells of smoke. A cracked section of the east wall is the only other way out.

L9:G8.name: Sage of the Northern Gate
L9:G8.description: Two fires flicker on either side of an old man who stands in this quiet room, his voice barely above a whisper as he speaks of hidden paths. A locked door with a keyhole leads south, and the west wall shows a cracked and weakened section.

L9:H8.name: Northeastern Sanctum
L9:H8.description: Scorch marks and a lingering cold presence fill this remote corner room. Stone blocks stand in neat rows, but one sits slightly out of line, with fresh scrapes at its base. The only exit is a cracked section of the south wall.

L9:cellar:A7.name: Silver Arrow Cellar
L9:cellar:A7.description: A ladder leads up from this narrow, side-cut basement, its walls of dark brick stacked in even rows. A hush hangs over the place, broken only by the drip of water somewhere in the dark. The floor runs level from end to end, with a raised ledge at its far side.

L9:cellar:H8.name: Red Ring Cellar
L9:cellar:H8.description: A narrow basement hollowed from the mountain's rock, reached by a ladder that rises toward the chamber above. The brick walls are warm to the touch, and a faint red glow seems to linger in the dust. A raised ledge stands at the far end of the level floor.

wooden_sword_cave.name: The Old Man's Cave
wooden_sword_cave.description: A low cave opens into the hillside, its walls black with the soot of two fires that never seem to burn down. The flames stand an equal distance apart, and the bare floor between them has been swept clean, as though someone has been waiting a long time for a visitor. It is dangerous out there, and this is the place that knows it.

white_sword_cave.name: The White Sword Cave
white_sword_cave.description: Spray from the waterfall drifts in at the mouth of this cave and beads on the rock. Two fires burn in shallow pits against the far wall, throwing a steady light across a floor scored by the boots of the few who climbed this high. The stone here is pale and clean, as if the mountain itself were holding something worth keeping.

master_sword_grave.name: Beneath the Hero's Grave
master_sword_grave.description: A narrow stair beneath the old headstone ends in a cold, close vault. Twin fires burn on either side of a worn stone plinth, and their light does not reach the corners. The air smells of earth and iron, and the silence has the weight of a promise made to whoever proved strong enough to come down here.

letter_cave.name: The Hermit's Cave
letter_cave.description: This cave sits high in the northeastern rocks where few travellers think to look. Two small fires warm a dry floor, and a writing desk has been made from a flat slab of stone. Whoever lives here keeps the place tidy and keeps to the old courtesies; the royal family's seal would be known here at a glance.

heart_cave_bomb.name: A Hidden Heart Grotto
heart_cave_bomb.description: Rubble from the shattered wall lies across the mouth of this little grotto. Beyond it the cave is dry and quiet, lit by two steady fires set into the floor. Something warm and red glows on a ledge between them, a gift left for anyone determined enough to blast their way in.

heart_cave_mountain.name: A Grotto in the Mountain
heart_cave_mountain.description: The blast that opened this cave left its walls raw and sharp, and dust still hangs in the firelight. The chamber beyond is small and surprisingly warm, sheltered from the wind that scours the mountain outside. A faint red pulse of light comes from the far end, steady as a heartbeat.

heart_cave_burn.name: Beneath the Burned Bush
heart_cave_burn.description: Ash from the burned bush has drifted down the steps into this hollow under the roots. Two fires burn here already, older than the one that opened the way, and the earthen walls are hung with pale threads of root. The place feels like a secret the forest kept for itself.

heart_island.name: The Raft Island
heart_island.description: A spit of sand and rock stands alone in open water, reachable only by raft from the dock on the shore. Waves lap at every side, and a single scrubby tree leans over a sheltered hollow in the middle. It is the kind of place a reward would be hidden: obvious from the shore and impossible to reach without the means.

heart_ledge.name: Across the Narrow Water
heart_ledge.description: This rocky ledge lies just beyond a channel of water too wide to step and too narrow to bother swimming. A traveller with a stepladder can bridge it in a moment. The ledge is quiet, sheltered from the coast wind by a shoulder of rock, and littered with gull feathers and driftwood.

secret_return_tree.name: Hollow of the Old Tree
secret_return_tree.description: The burned bush opened onto a hollow beneath the roots of an enormous old tree. The walls are packed earth and root, and the light here is strange: it seems to come from somewhere other than Hyrule. A soft hum fills the hollow, and the air carries a faint smell of dust, coins and arcade lights.

power_bracelet_alcove.name: Under the Armos Statue
power_bracelet_alcove.description: The statue that guarded this spot has been moved, and beneath it lies a shallow stone alcove cut square into the bedrock. Its walls bear faded carvings of a hand gripping a mountain. The space is just large enough to kneel in, and it was clearly made to keep one small thing safe.

rupee_burn.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
rupee_burn.description: The burned bush revealed a short stair down into a cosy earthen cave. Two fires crackle in the gloom, and the floor between them is scuffed by heavy, clawed feet. Whoever lives here is generous with strangers, provided the strangers keep quiet about where they found the money.

rupee_bomb.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
rupee_bomb.description: Broken stone from the bombed wall lies just inside this cramped cave. Two fires burn in the dark, and their light catches a few loose glints on the floor. The place has the cheerful untidiness of someone who hides coin for a living and expects to be found now and then.

rupee_armos.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
rupee_armos.description: A narrow stair hides beneath the base of the moved Armos statue. Below, a small cave is lit by two fires and furnished with nothing at all. Someone has scratched a grinning face into the wall beside the steps, and under it, very small, the words keep it quiet.

rupee_open.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
rupee_open.description: This cave sits in plain sight on the eastern shore, which may be why nobody bothers to look in it. Two fires burn on either side of the floor, warming a chamber that smells of salt and seaweed. The secret of the place is not where it is, but how much it gives away.

shop.name: A Merchant's Cave
shop.description: Two fires light a dry, low-ceilinged cave where three wares are laid out in a neat row on the bare floor. A painted price is set beneath each one in rupees, and there is no haggling. The merchant has chosen this spot carefully: close enough to the road for trade, far enough from it for safety.

shop_secret.name: A Hidden Merchant's Cave
shop_secret.description: This cave was hidden behind rock or root, and the merchant who trades here prefers it that way. Two fires burn in the dim, and a short row of goods sits on a woven mat with prices set out beneath them. The prices are kinder than in the open caves, as a reward for finding the place.

potion_shop.name: The Medicine Woman's Cave
potion_shop.description: Bundles of dried herbs hang from the ceiling of this warm cave, and two fires keep the damp off a row of stoppered bottles. The air smells of bitter roots and sweet syrup. Nothing is for sale to strangers here: the old woman who keeps the shop wants proof that the royal family sent you.

door_repair.name: The Door-Repair Charge
door_repair.description: A freshly mended door frame stands just inside this cave, its timbers too new for the old rock around it. Two fires light a floor swept clean, and a ledger lies open on a stone ledge. The owner believes firmly that whoever opened the way should pay for the damage, and keeps a careful account.

gamble.name: A Money-Making Game
gamble.description: Three overturned signs lie on the floor of this cave, each hiding a sum painted on its underside. Two fires throw their light across them evenly, so nothing gives away which is which. The game is honest, in its way: anybody can play, and anybody can lose.

warp_hall.name: The Warp Stairway Hall
warp_hall.description: Beneath the moved stone a short stair descends into a long, bare hall cut from the bedrock. Three dark stairways open in its far wall, each worn smooth by long use and each leading a very long way under the land. A carving over them reads, in old letters, take any road you want.
